system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
Hi, I recently purchased a new Samsung gear S3 frontier and the Spotify app doesn't let me log in. It says log in failed but I use the same login on my PC and it works. Help!!

PREDICTED INTENT: login_access

PRECEDENTS:

[272517] (similarity 0.72, intent login_access)
  past customer: I can't login to my Spotify acct thru the Groove app to move my music over. Checked the credentials on my phone too
  spotify replied: 1: Hi there! You'll be able to move your music from Groove to Spotify starting from the 9th of October. More info here...

[2019738] (similarity 0.71, intent login_access)
  past customer: hi guys, my spotify wont log in, please help
  spotify replied: Hey Jordan! Are you getting any error messages when logging in? Also, what device and Spotify version are you using? We'll help you out

[361501] (similarity 0.71, intent login_access)
  past customer: hi. My Spotify app won't work. It won't even log me in. It glitches up
  spotify replied: Hey, help's here! Can you tell us what's happening? We'll see what we can suggest

[687031] (similarity 0.70, intent login_access)
  past customer: I can't log into spotify application on my computer. All I get is the message 'service is temporarily unavailable, please try again later. (Error code: 404). Been like this for a week. Phone and desktop working fine.
  spotify replied: Hey Emma! Could you send us a screenshot of the error code, so we can check it out?

[2005811] (similarity 0.69, intent login_access)
  past customer: Hi, I have trouble logging in to my Spotify via facebook, I've tried several times in the past few weeks, it doesn't let me in
  spotify replied: Hey Ivet! Don't worry, help's here. Can you let us know your account's email address? We'll take a look backstage /AP <link>

Draft the reply as JSON.
